title: Theo and the Orchard
author: Marguerite Reyes
blurb: Elodie Crane, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
